findings.title: A terminal writer can expose an immutable partial terminal.json
findings.impact: A crash after creating terminal.json but before completing and flushing its JSON can leave an invalid file that existing-terminal-wins semantics preserve forever.
findings.required_revision: Serialize and validate the complete closed record in a same-directory temporary file, flush it, atomically publish it to terminal.json with no-replace semantics, and require losing publishers to validate the winner. Treat an invalid published terminal as blocking ledger corruption and never overwrite it. Add provider-unreachable interruption and publication-race tests.

assessments.terminal_ownership_order: Child-preferred, wrapper-fallback, and resume-reconciler ownership is otherwise coherent.
